how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Made on demand, shipped from a partner near you.

steps.title: 1 · Choose
steps.text: Pick a design, then your size and color. Preview the delivery estimate for your country on every product page.

steps.title: 2 · Order
steps.text: Pay securely. Your order is sent automatically to the print partner closest to your address.

steps.title: 3 · We print
steps.text: Your item is printed, embroidered or sublimated on demand and quality-checked before packing.

steps.title: 4 · It ships
steps.text: You get a tracking link by email. Most orders arrive within 1–2 weeks worldwide.

how.partners_text: We work with leading print-on-demand networks so your order is made close to home.

creators.title: Creators
creators.subtitle: Meet the artists behind our designs.
creators.story_text: Daebak (대박) means “awesome” — what you say when something surprises you in the best way. We started by printing friends’ illustrations on tees. Today we partner with independent artists and print networks worldwide to make Korean-inspired design easy to wear and own.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about orders, printing and delivery.
faq.more_text: Our assistant answers instantly, and our team replies within one business day.

items.a: Your item is printed only after you order it, by a partner near you. That means no overstock and slightly longer lead time than ready-made items.
Production takes 2–7 business days, then shipping takes 2–14 days depending on the country. Check the estimate on each product page.
Yes. Use the Track order page with your order number and email. You also receive a tracking link once it ships.
Because items are made for you, we do not accept returns for wrong size. Defective or damaged items are reprinted or refunded within 30 days — just send a photo.
Use the size guide on apparel pages. Our tees and hoodies are unisex and relaxed — size down if you prefer a closer fit.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. All payments are encrypted.

items.q: Will I pay customs or import taxes?
items.a: Orders to the EU and UK are shipped duty-paid when possible. Elsewhere, local customs may apply and are the buyer’s responsibility.

items.q: Can I order a custom design?
items.a: Yes — visit the Custom studio, send your artwork and we will reply within 48 hours with mockups and a quote.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
items.a: Contact us within 12 hours of ordering. Once production has started, changes are no longer possible.

items.q: Are the colors on screen accurate?
items.a: We use official mockups and calibrated profiles, but screens vary. Expect small differences in tone, especially on dark garments.

shipping.title: Shipping & returns
shipping.subtitle: Transparent delivery times, costs and our reprint guarantee.
shipping.note: Delivery times start after production. Remote areas may take longer.

sections.title: Production
sections.text: Every item is made to order. Production takes 2–7 business days depending on the product. Multi-item orders may ship in several parcels.

sections.title: Returns & reprints
sections.text: Defective, damaged or misprinted items are reprinted or refunded within 30 days of delivery. Send us your order number and a photo.

sections.title: Lost or delayed parcels
sections.text: If tracking has not moved for 10 days, contact us and we will open an investigation with the carrier or reship your order.

sections.title: Customs & duties
sections.text: Import duties and taxes depend on your country and are not included unless shown at checkout.
